measurementFunction: (checks) => {const parse=s=>{const n=(s.match(/[\d.]+/g)||[]).map(Number);return s.startsWith('color(srgb ')?n.map((v,i)=>i<3?v*255:v):n;};const over=(a,b)=>{const alpha=a[3]??1;return a.slice(0,3).map((v,i)=>v*alpha+b[i]*(1-alpha));};const lum=c=>{const v=c.map(x=>{x/=255;return x<=.04045?x/12.92:((x+.055)/1.055)**2.4;});return v[0]*.2126+v[1]*.7152+v[2]*.0722;};const rows=[];for(const c of checks){const check=typeof c==='string'?{selector:c}:c;for(const el of document.querySelectorAll(check.selector)){const detail=el.closest('details');if(el.closest('[hidden],dialog:not([open])')||(detail&&!detail.hasAttribute('open')&&!el.closest('summary')))continue;const st=getComputedStyle(el,check.pseudo||null),r=el.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width||!r.height||st.visibility==='hidden')continue;let chain=[],node=el;while(node){chain.unshift(node);node=node.parentElement;}let bg=[255,255,255];for(const n of chain)bg=over(parse(getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor),bg);const fg=over(parse(st.color),bg),a=lum(fg),b=lum(bg),ratio=(Math.max(a,b)+.05)/(Math.min(a,b)+.05);rows.push({selector:check.selector,pseudo:check.pseudo||null,text:el.textContent.trim().slice(0,55),color:st.color,bg:bg.map(Math.round),ratio:Number(ratio.toFixed(2)),minimum:check.min||4.5,pass:ratio>=(check.min||4.5)});}}return{theme:document.documentElement.dataset.theme||'system',systemLight:matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches,rows,failures:rows.filter(x=>!x.pass).length};}
